correctness.rationale: Direct unit-row Gram decomposition gives contrast eigenvalues and 2x2 coupled spectral mode. The symbolic identity det(H(t)-L0 I)=-kappa(t-t0)^2, contrast intersections and sign qac-qd²-sd prove exact three regimes with boundary continuity. Positive-semidefinite averaging equality and full nonzero critical-mode coordinates give unrestricted uniqueness. Packaged code reproduces the identity symbolically, four exact-rational cases, 560 parameter/optimizer checks and 13,440 asymmetry checks; finite checks are corroboration, not proof.

value.rationale: A positive-definite two-cluster Gram of normalized measurement rows is a natural design abstraction for correlated sensing systems, and selecting individual rows optimally determines a sharp one-step projection contraction. Both groups have repeated directions; the competing transverse modes create a nontrivial middle sampling phase and two sharp phase boundaries. Closed allocation, sharp optimal contraction and unrestricted optimizer uniqueness provide actionable structural content beyond generic numerical SDP and beyond one-exception-row results.
